translations.web: He commanded them, saying, “Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Don’t go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.
translations.bsb: with these orders: “Pay attention. You are to lie in ambush behind the city, not too far from it. All of you must be ready.
translations.kjv: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:
